NetTerm 0.3.0

A serial terminal (ANSI / VT100) for the Analogue Pocket: 80 x 24 with a
status line, on the link port or the cartridge slot, 300 to 921,600 baud,
3.3 V TTL levels. Type on a USB keyboard in the Dock, or on the on-screen
keyboard (Select). Port, speed, echo and line endings are in the core's menu.

https://github.com/Miasmark/openfpga-netterm
